lines: No delivered file in build carries a source map, so none of these 206,400 B can be charged to the package it came from.

Without maps nobody can say what the bundle consists of, the app's own maintainer included, and no finding below can be priced. @nextcloud/vite-config sets build.sourcemap, which is what makes the per-package figures in this report possible.
Built with: vite.config.ts, package.json declares @nextcloud/vite-config 2.5.2 (locked 2.5.2), vite ^7.3.6 (locked 7.3.6).
No package the build delivers is imported by its root in src: every one of the 11 packages it imports is named by the module that is used.
